meta.title: Entire-lot award option runs the auction at lot level
gaps: Directly assert from the live auction that bidding and ranks are calculated for the lot as a whole rather than separately per line item.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly assert from the live auction that bidding and ranks are calculated for the lot as a whole rather than separately per line item.

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for auction strategy and awarding configuration.
Select an auction with rank-based bidding and the entire-lot award option.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Create multiple line items so the lot-level auction has a whole lot to operate on.
Add a participant so the auction can be published and bid on.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Place a buyer-entered bid for the invited vendor to create live auction ranking data.
Verify that the bid was accepted.
Open the live comparison view containing the auction bid and ranking information.
Verify that the live auction exposes ranking data ordered by the lowest amount.
